sentences.text:
Main Case No: W.P.No.29470 of 2023
 Proceeding Sheet
Sl. Office
 Date Order
No. Note.
 01 10-11-2023 Rc,J
 Notice before admission.
The learned Government Pleader for Land  Acquisition takes notice for the respondent Nos. 1 to 3.

The learned Government Pleader for Revenue takes notice for respondent No.4.
Post on 28.11.2023 for instructions.
RC,J I.A.No.1 of 2023 Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Assistant government Pleader for Land Acquisition.

Sri Md. Saleem, learned counsel for the petitioners, contended that pursuant to the preliminary notification in Form No.6(a) issued under Section 11(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 calling for objections to the proposed acquisition of lands for providing Burial ground, the petitioners submitted their objections under section 15 of the Act on 26.10.2023 and the concerned authority has received the same within the time stipulated as per the Act.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: However, the authorities without passing any orders as required under the Act are proceeding further, which is illegal, arbitrary and against the provisions of the Act,2013.

If the authorities are not injuncted by orders of stay and they are permitted to proceed with the acquisition process, the purpose of filing this Writ Petition would become infructuous and the rights of the petitioners would adversely be affected.

Copies of the objections submitted by the petitioners to the authorities coupled with postal receipts and acknowledgments show that the objections submitted by the petitioners has duly been received by the 3rd respondent-Sub Collector, who has been appointed as Land Acquisition Officer, within the time stipulated under the Act.
As per the scheme of the Act the Land Acquisition Officer shall dispose of the objections, if any, received before proceeding further.
Thus, prima facie a point is made out for consideration to be decided in this writ petition.

As rightly contended by the learned counsel for the petitioner in case the authorities proceed with the further course of action pursuant to the preliminary notification, this writ petition would become infructuous.

Therefore, this Court is inclined to grant the following interim order:
"there shall be stay of all further proceedings pursuant to the preliminary notification Syed Ajmal Hussain vs The State Of Ap on 10 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/117132926/
1 published in Form 6(A) of the Act,2013 till 28.11.2023."
